name: Claim Guard
description: before_agent_finalize: a reply that claims a save, a schedule, a promise to remember, or a logged meal count — in a turn where no state-capable tool call succeeded — is sent back for one more model pass with the instruction to run the owning script or say plainly that nothing was saved. Built after the 2026-09-20 accuracy audit: counts from scripts were right 10/10, counts and 'Logged' claims made with zero tool calls were wrong every time.
